conduct_ethics_002.evidence: Article 16 PROFESSIONAL RESPONSIBILITY: 'C. Each teacher is to be treated in a professional manner at all times. D. Teachers are to treat other employees of the system in a professional manner at all times.'

conduct_academic_freedom_007.evidence: Article 11 ACADEMIC AND PERSONAL FREEDOM: 'B. Both parties agree that no legitimate issue of controversy in our society should be excluded from the classroom. However, all sides of controversial issues must be presented.'
